how_verified: Every quote was checked by downloading its page with curl -sS -m 40, stripping tags (script and style blocks removed, each tag replaced by a space), unescaping entities, collapsing whitespace, and testing for the exact string. Quotes taken from tables or lists therefore read as cell or item text joined by single spaces. Quotes were chosen to contain no em dashes.

products.name: Adobe Brand Visibility

what.text: Adobe's application for showing up in AI answers: it measures how a brand appears in AI-generated answers, recommends content and technical fixes, and can deploy some of them at the CDN edge.
what.quote: Adobe Brand Visibility is a generative AI-first application for Generative Engine Optimization, designed to help brands enhance their visibility, accuracy, and influence in AI-driven search environments.

products.status_note: Earlier name: Adobe LLM Optimizer. Adobe's release notes date the rename and general availability under the new name to 2026-08-04; Adobe's product description page for LLM Optimizer gives 21 August 2026. Some admin objects keep the old name (the "Adobe LLM Optimizer Users" product profile, the "LLMO Admin" group).

status_source.quote: Find out how LLM Optimizer has evolved into Adobe Brand Visibility, now combining Adobe’s optimization capabilities with Semrush’s market intelligence in a single workflow.

bv.how: This entry is Brand Visibility itself.

connections.how: Brand Visibility reads aggregated Adobe Analytics metrics (through the Adobe Analytics APIs) for one report suite and one page dimension into the Business Impact tab of its Referral Traffic dashboard. Paid offer only. Set up from Brands Management with the user's own Adobe sign-in, no Developer Console project. Four full weeks are backfilled, then a daily pull.
connections.quote: The Adobe Analytics integration connects Adobe Brand Visibility with your organization’s Adobe Analytics data so you can measure how AI-driven discovery translates into real website engagement and business outcomes.

more_quotes.quote: The Adobe Analytics integration is included in the paid Adobe Brand Visibility offer.
Adobe Brand Visibility works with aggregated metrics from the Adobe Analytics APIs authorized by your organization not the raw hit-level data.
You do not need to create an Adobe Developer Console project or provide a technical account, Client ID, or Client Secret.
Paying customers can connect Adobe Analytics to measure referral traffic and business impact.
Connect Adobe Brand Visibility with your organization’s Adobe Analytics data so you can measure how AI-driven discovery translates into real website engagement and business outcomes.

connections.to_name: Adobe Experience Platform (Sources catalog: the Adobe Brand Visibility source)
connections.how: The customer turns on the Adobe Brand Visibility source in one Experience Platform sandbox (Sources, Catalog, Adobe applications). It creates one aggregated summary dataset per Brand Visibility site from the CDN logs; the customer then adds that dataset to a Customer Journey Analytics connection and data view. Needs the paid offering and working CDN log forwarding. A site can be allocated to one dataflow in one sandbox only.
connections.quote: The inbound integration provides an aggregated summary dataset in Experience Platform that contains server-side CDN request information associated with LLM, bot, and automated-agent traffic.

more_quotes.quote: You must have a Brand Visibility paid offering. You then configure and enable the Adobe Brand Visibility source in your Experience Platform sandbox.
CDN access logs must be forwarded to and received by Adobe Brand Visibility for each Brand Visibility site before the Brand Visibility source connector can be viable.
Once a site is allocated to a dataflow, you cannot select the site again in that or any other sandbox.
As part of this integration, some temporary processing of Brand Visibility data occurs in the United States.

connections.catalog_note: The catalog's bv-cja card already mentions "an Experience Platform source"; Experience Platform is not a catalog product on its own.

connections.how: Brand Visibility's AI Visibility dashboard runs on Semrush Enterprise AIO's prompt database, Semrush is one of the four sources of prompt suggestions in Prompt Strategy, and the paid Brand Presence view is labelled "powered by Semrush". The Brand Visibility license includes a Semrush Enterprise AIO license with stated limits.
connections.quote: Powered by Semrush Enterprise AIO, AI Visibility uses Semrush’s AI data set, including a database of more than 289M prompts, to provide immediate insight into how brands are represented in AI-generated responses.

more_quotes.quote: Customer’s license to Adobe Brand Visibility includes a license for Customer to access and use Semrush Enterprise AIO in accordance with the following limits
Semrush analyzes how brands appear in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview, and Google AI Mode.

Powered by recommendations from Semrush, Google Search Console, Synthetic Personas, and Citation Attempt, Prompt Strategy surfaces topics where your brand has an opportunity to improve visibility as well as topics where your brand already performs well.

Brand Presence powered by Semrush builds on the core monitoring capabilities available in the Trial experience by providing richer competitive intelligence, broader AI platform coverage, and deeper analytics.

connections.how: Tutorial video page in the Coworker guide only: in a campaign-launch walkthrough Coworker pulls live market intelligence from Semrush, which the page calls part of Adobe Brand Visibility (how the brand ranks against competitors, what people search). The Brand Visibility guide itself never names Coworker, and Coworker's workflows catalog lists no Brand Visibility or Semrush skill.
connections.quote: blends first-party Experience Platform data with live market intelligence from SEMrush, and then builds the audience, customer journey, content experiment, and landing page

more_quotes.quote: now part of Adobe Brand Visibility
Shows how you rank against competitors and the searches travelers actually make.

connections.how: Two directions. Inbound: Brand Visibility's CDN-log summary dataset lands in Experience Platform and is analyzed in CJA. Outbound: Brand Visibility reads aggregated CJA report data from a chosen data view into the Business Impact tab of Referral Traffic. The outbound side is available once it has been enabled for the organization.
connections.quote: The Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) integration connects Adobe Brand Visibility with your organization’s CJA data so you can measure how AI-driven discovery translates into real website engagement, conversions, and business outcomes.

more_quotes.quote: Use Brand Visibility data in Customer Journey Analytics to measure LLM-driven traffic (bot crawlers, RAG requests, agent activity) alongside existing web, mobile, and other types of data.
The CJA integration is available once it has been enabled for your organization.

connections.to_name: AEM Sites (AEM as a Cloud Service managed CDN, Cloud Manager, Experience Hub)
connections.how: On AEM as a Cloud Service's managed CDN (Fastly) the Optimize at Edge routing is switched on inside Brand Visibility. Adobe provisions a service integration named AEM Managed CDN Integration, holding the Cloud Manager Deployment Manager role, so Brand Visibility can change the CDN's agentic-traffic routing rules. AEM Cloud customers can start the Brand Visibility trial from Experience Hub.
connections.quote: For AEM Cloud Service managed Fastly customers, the routing setup is self-serve and can be completed directly in the Adobe Brand Visibility UI.

more_quotes.quote: Allows the LLM Optimizer service to update your AEM as a Cloud Service Managed CDN agentic-traffic routing rules on your behalf
Navigate to Experience Hub and use the Product Announcement card to activate Adobe Brand Visibility.
Paid customers must have access to the Adobe LLM Optimizer Users IMS Product Profile.

connections.how: The Brand Visibility guide names Edge Delivery once, to say Optimize at Edge is not limited to Edge Delivery sites; it describes no Edge Delivery specific setup. On aem.live, Adobe's SEO and GEO page recommends LLM Optimizer (the earlier name).
connections.quote: Optimize at Edge is CDN-agnostic and works with any front-end architecture, not just the ones deployed on Adobe’s EDS Stack.

more_quotes.quote: Adobe recommends using LLM Optimizer to ensure your site is represented in the best possible light when users search for relevant keywords in LLMs.

connections.to_name: Adobe Commerce (Commerce catalog, Adobe Commerce Catalog Agent)
connections.how: Two opportunities. Enrich Product Catalog writes rewritten product names and descriptions into the Commerce catalog (Adobe labels it Beta). Enrich Product Detail Pages reads the catalog and serves the missing product data to AI agents at the CDN edge. Both need Brand Visibility connected to the Commerce instance; the connection steps are not in the guide.
connections.quote: Catalog Enrichment requires Adobe Brand Visibility to be connected to Adobe Commerce.

more_quotes.quote: This opportunity is currently in Beta and can be activated by Adobe Commerce customers.
Deploying optimizations requires (1) connecting Adobe Brand Visibility to Adobe Commerce and (2) completing the Optimize at Edge onboarding process.
click Deploy Optimizations to publish the updated product name and description to your Adobe Commerce catalog.

connections.to_name: CDN, log forwarding (Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Fastly, Imperva, or manual upload)
connections.how: The customer's CDN sends access logs to an Amazon S3 bucket Adobe provides; Brand Visibility reads them for the Agentic Traffic and Referral Traffic dashboards. Adobe has a guide for Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront (console and AWS CLI), Fastly and Imperva, plus a manual-upload guide for any other CDN.
connections.quote: Log forwarding for a customer managed CDN (BYOCDN) is the process of sending your CDN access logs to Adobe’s Amazon S3 bucket so that Adobe Brand Visibility can collect and analyze agentic traffic data.

more_quotes.quote: To unlock Agentic Traffic and Referral Traffic insights, register CDN log forwarding so Adobe Brand Visibility can read your access logs.

connections.to_name: CDN, Optimize at Edge routing (AEM managed Fastly, Fastly, Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Azure Front Door, Apache HTTP Server)
connections.how: A second CDN tie, separate from log forwarding: the customer's outer CDN routes AI-agent requests to Adobe's Edge Optimize service so deployed fixes reach AI agents only. Adobe has setup guides for AEM Cloud Service managed CDN (Fastly), Fastly, Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Azure Front Door and Apache HTTP Server. Azure Front Door and Apache appear only here; Imperva appears only under log forwarding.
connections.quote: Routing must be configured at the outer CDN (the CDN closest to the client).

more_quotes.quote: For customers using other CDN providers, your IT/CDN team needs to complete the required setup and prerequisites.
This configuration applies when Apache HTTP Server acts as the reverse proxy in front of your origin (a self-hosted setup, without AEM Dispatcher).

connections.catalog_note: The catalog lists the CDN for log forwarding; the Azure Front Door and Apache HTTP Server guides for Optimize at Edge are the part to check against it.

connections.how: The customer connects a Google Search Console account; its real search queries become suggested prompts (a person picks them), feed Synthetic Persona suggestions, and add search context to opportunities.
connections.quote: Connect Google Search Console to enrich Adobe Brand Visibility with search performance data.

more_quotes.quote: Adobe Brand Visibility allows you to integrate your Google Search Console account to bring real search queries directly into the interface.
To generate Synthetic Persona suggestions, connect Google Search Console for your brand.

connections.how: Brand Visibility reads aggregated GA4 report data (GA4 Data API, read-only, Google sign-in) for sessions GA4 attributes to AI sources into the Business Impact tab. Paid offer only.
connections.quote: The Google Analytics 4 (GA4) integration connects Adobe Brand Visibility with your organization’s GA4 data so you can measure how AI-driven discovery on platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude and Perplexity translates into real website engagement and business outcomes.

more_quotes.quote: The GA4 integration is included in the paid Adobe Brand Visibility offer.

connections.how: Access control (paid customers, on request) is set by assigning the Brand Visibility product profile to users or groups in the Admin Console; product-assigned users can deploy fixes and manage the CDN and Search Console settings, everyone else is read-only.
connections.quote: A system administrator for your organization can use the Adobe Admin Console to assign Adobe Brand Visibility to a user or group.
connections.catalog_note: A platform service, not a product to place on the canvas.

connections.to_name: AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Perplexity; Claude for edge delivery)
connections.how: Outside systems Brand Visibility reads from and serves to: it runs the tracked prompts on these engines to measure the brand, and Optimize at Edge delivers the fixed pages to the agents of ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude.
connections.quote: Adobe Brand Visibility currently supports ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft Co-pilot, Google Gemini, and Perplexity.

more_quotes.quote: Optimize at Edge delivers supported opportunities to ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, covering the largest and most impactful share of LLM traffic.

connections.catalog_note: Outside systems; Brand Visibility connects to them itself, nothing for the customer to set up.

connections.to_name: Off-site sources: Wikipedia, YouTube, Reddit and other cited web pages
connections.how: Brand Visibility reads these public sources (it scrapes the company's Wikipedia page; it analyzes the YouTube videos, Reddit threads and web pages that AI answers cite) and returns recommendations. It does not write to them.
connections.quote: Adobe Brand Visibility scrapes your company’s Wikipedia page and compares it against a set of industry competitors identified automatically based on your business category.

more_quotes.quote: Adobe Brand Visibility monitors YouTube videos cited by AI systems for prompts in your Brand Presence dashboard prompt set.
Adobe Brand Visibility monitors Reddit threads cited by AI systems for prompts in your Brand Presence dashboard prompt set.

connections.catalog_note: Read-only analysis of public pages; no customer setup.

connections.to_name: Log stores and serverless jobs for manual log upload (Splunk, Elasticsearch, AWS Lambda, Azure Function)
connections.how: For a CDN without a built-in guide, Adobe describes exporting logs from an observability platform or a serverless job, reshaping them to Adobe's JSON Lines schema and uploading them to the Adobe-provided S3 path.
connections.quote: Retrieve logs from existing observability platforms and deliver them to the S3 location.

more_quotes.quote: Extract the required fields from Splunk/Elastic search events.

products.name: Adobe Brand Intelligence

what.text: A headless, API-based service (documented under Adobe Firefly help) that learns a company's brand rules from its guidelines, assets and review feedback, then checks content against them (Validate), assembles on-brand variants from a brief (Instruct to Assemble) and tests creative on a synthetic audience (Simulate).
what.quote: Adobe Brand Intelligence is a continuously learning brand intelligence platform that helps your teams create and validate on-brand content faster and with less effort.

products.status_note: Publicly documented in three places: Adobe Firefly web help (helpx.adobe.com), developer.adobe.com/adobe-brand-intelligence, and two product descriptions on helpx.adobe.com/legal (Adobe Brand Intelligence, effective 2 October 2026, and an earlier "Adobe's Brand Intelligence Service", effective 30 March 2026). No Experience League guide found. To work it needs at least one licensed Brand, one Skills add-on, Operations from Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise or Shared Credits, and Adobe Forward-Deployed Engineering resources.

status_source.quote: At least one Adobe Brand Intelligence Brand, At least one Adobe Brand Intelligence Skills Add-On, Operations (either through the Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise offering or the Shared Credits offering), and Adobe Forward-Deployed Engineering resources.

connections.how: A Workfront AI Reviewer (an AI Collaborator assigned as a reviewer on assets) can be set to use Adobe Brand Intelligence instead of a Workfront brand. The organization must use Workfront's unified review and approval experience.

more_quotes.quote: To use Adobe Brand Intelligence for an AI Reviewer, your organization must use the unified review and approval experience in Workfront.
You can easily integrate it into apps such as Workfront and Frame.

connections.quote: When an AI Collaborator reviews an asset using Adobe Brand Intelligence, you can view comments made by the AI Reviewer in Frame.io.
